svg.title: Bend Emblem — 1912 historical reconstruction (1912-white)
svg.desc: Historical reconstruction of the Bend Emblem as printed in the Bend Bulletin of 3 July 1912, cut from a trace of that advertisement. The double ring, the irregular letterforms and the heavy strokes are the 1912 specimen's own; they differ from the later, lighter form the project calls the common emblem. The small central copyright symbol visible in the newspaper is deliberately not reproduced (Grayson's decision, 2026-09-10): the mark is given away freely, and a copyright glyph on it would say the opposite of what the project means.
